limitations: Link exact workflow/context/epoch/JOIN and child request identities; no ordinal fallback.
Only service/EOS records timestamped before rejection are causal inputs; completion is a diagnostic label.
Last selected stage is not proof of current in-memory stage/ticket state after event drain.
output_tokens_before is a conservative token lower bound, not a reconstructed exact runtime progress counter.
Recent service does not prove current running-batch membership; EOS does not prove a normal no-tool stop.
Do not infer service starvation or fix runtime timing from the generic rejection label alone.
